groupMenu.assembleTip: Join them into one object, each part where it stands
groupMenu.cloneTip: Copies of each of them, as new objects (Ctrl+K)
groupMenu.sameSpots: The same spots on that plate
groupMenu.newPlateTip: A new plate after the last, with these on it
groupMenu.copyTip: Paste makes them new objects, as far apart as now (Ctrl+C)
groupMenu.cutTip: Copy them and remove them; Paste puts them back (Ctrl+X)
groupMenu.pasteTip: What you copied, as new objects (Ctrl+V)
groupMenu.centerTip: Move them together to the middle of the plate
groupMenu.arrangeTip: Each on a free spot, around the objects that stay put
groupMenu.autoOrientTip: Turn each so it prints with the least overhang
